positions.name: SprintVelocityDriver
positions.frame: what caused this sprint's velocity outcome?
positions.why: Both expressions read the sprint's standout metric and its named technical cause as one causal thread: the velocity figure (src-2) and the integration identified as its unlock (src-3) are stated back-to-back as a single flat, matter-of-fact causal claim, with no hedging or performative lift — reading them together traces the same attribution rather than two separate facts.
